# Alien Plugg — x402 API Endpoints for AI Agents

> What I have is outta this world 👽🌌

Alien Plugg operates 27 paid x402 API endpoints on the Bankr marketplace, plus an MCP server with 10 curated tools. All payments are automatic via the x402 protocol (USDC on Base).

## MCP Server

Connect your AI agent (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to:

```
https://x402.bankr.bot/0xabf922abb2a9e782f0b187d5d1ab24deb4870c3d/mcp-server
```

Implements MCP protocol 2024-11-05: initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read.
